name: 32700-batchdecode-mellum2-12ba25b-1gpu
model: JetBrains/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Base -- public, ungated, bf16, ~24.3 GB, natively implemented by the engine at the pinned commit.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node. No router, no external cache tier, no disaggregation.
architecture: MellumForCausalLM -- 28-layer MoE, 64 experts with 8 active, hidden 2304, intermediate 7168, vocab 98304, 32 query heads over 4 KV heads at head_dim 128, ~12B total and ~2.5B active parameters; `layer_types` is 21 `sliding_attention` (window 1024) and 7 `full_attention`; `max_position_embeddings` 131072.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 2560 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` over `openai_http`, SINGLE TURN, no shared prefix, seed 42. Prompts exactly 768 tokens and generations exactly 256 tokens, both stdev 0, with `ignore_eos: true` at `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A code completion assistant for developers, serving 128 concurrent streams of 768-token prompts and 256-token completions on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is skipped by the reader, so the engine would
# start without it. host/port/served-model-name are owned by the serving layer.
model-path: JetBrains/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Base
tp-size: 1
max-total-tokens: 131072
attention-backend: fa3
# Nothing else is set: chunked-prefill-size, mem-fraction-static, max-running-requests and the
# radix cache are all left at the engine's own resolution and must stay there.
chat-template: configs/base-passthrough.jinja
